# F14 - Recent Patients Navigation

**Source:** Functional Requirements > Search and Navigation | Functional

**Description:** The doctor can access recent patients and quickly navigate between profile and visits.

## Scenarios

### Scenario 1: View recent patients
Given recent consultation activity exists  
When the recent patients panel is opened  
Then patients are listed in recency order

### Scenario 2: Navigate between profile and visits
Given a patient profile is open  
When the visits view is selected  
Then visit history for the same patient is displayed
